name: IC 4026 (Webb)
blurb: IC 4026, a galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ic4026-webb
story: A galaxy among the crowd of the Coma Cluster, the nearest rich cluster of galaxies. Webb studied the subtle surface brightness fluctuations of its starlight to help build a new ladder of distances for measuring how fast the universe expands.

claims.text: IC 4026 is one of the large galaxies in the Coma Cluster targeted by Webb program 5989
The Coma Cluster is the nearest rich cluster and a key touchstone for the distance scale
Webb measured surface brightness fluctuations (SBF) to build a distance ladder aimed at the Hubble constant
